text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: After finishing a training session with Smart Falcon…

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: Mmm-mmm! It's the magical twilight hour, and I've got the track all to myself!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: Talk about the stars aligning! It's exactly the chance I've been waiting for! ☆

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: Hehe… I mean the chance for a dramatic training session, of course!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: No emotional Umadol documentary would be complete without a scene of her working her butt off behind the scenes! ♪

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: So, Trainer! ☆ Is it okay if I do some extra training now?

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: So, Trainer! ☆ Is it okay if I do some extra training now?

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: Yay! Now we're talking! ♪

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: In that case—take this, Trainer!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: I want you to record me giving it my all! ☆

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: Bingo! ☆

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: 'Cause I'm absolutely, positively going to become a top Umadol!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: You have to get all the rare footage of me while you still can! ♪

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Smart Falcon puts her all into her extra training session… while occasionally mugging for the camera.

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: Huh?! Wh-why not?!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: This is so I can stand center stage and become a top Umadol!
choice_data_list: If you want to become a top Umadol, you need plenty of rest, too!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: Oof!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: Come on, Trainer… Don't say it like that. It's not faaair…

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: Sniffle… Fiiine… I'll make sure to rest up…

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Although Smart Falcon makes a big show of looking down, she agrees to properly rest and recuperate.
